policyNote: robots.txt blocks GPTBot/CCBot but allows some AI retrieval agents; however the terms limit downloads to personal, non-commercial use and forbid exploiting content in any way without permission. Conservative default.

name: Global Voices
policyNote: Site licensed CC BY 3.0 unless otherwise stated (globalvoices.org/about/global-voices-attribution-policy); commercial use allowed with credit and link. Third-party photos/audio/video may differ. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Feed carries full text.

name: Mongabay
policyNote: Articles CC BY-ND 4.0 (news.mongabay.com/copyright/creative-commons); asks republishers not to sell material separately or republish behind paywalls. GFRN partner content is CC BY-NC-ND. Third-party photos excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Feed carries excerpts.

name: Agência Pública
policyNote: Reports distributed under CC BY-ND 4.0 (apublica.org/republique); own rules forbid reselling reports and cutting or editing them; newsletter columns excluded. robots.txt is empty. Feed carries full text.

name: European Commission Press Corner
policyNote: EU-owned content licensed CC BY 4.0 under Decision 2011/833/EU (commission.europa.eu/legal-notice_en); logos, trade marks and third-party works excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Feed carries short descriptions; press-corner pages are rendered client-side.

name: European Central Bank
policyNote: ECB site terms allow free use with the ECB cited as source; if included in sold documents, buyers must be told the information is free on ecb.europa.eu. Signed working papers excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Feed mixes press releases, speeches and interviews; no body text.

name: GOV.UK
policyNote: Content under the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where stated (gov.uk/help/terms-conditions); commercial reuse allowed with attribution; logos and third-party material excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Feed carries summaries; high volume across departments.

name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
policyNote: Most CDC content is public domain (cdc.gov/other/agencymaterials.html); requires 'Source: CDC' attribution, a no-endorsement disclaimer and no change to substantive content; contractor, third-party and stock items excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents; edge blocks some user agents. The unparameterised feed returns its whole archive (1,800+ items since 2006); `?max=25` limits it to the latest items.

name: NOAA
policyNote: US federal government work, public domain under 17 U.S.C. 105; third-party images may differ. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Low-volume feed with summaries only.

name: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
policyNote: sec.gov information is public and 'may be copied or further distributed ... without the SEC's permission' (sec.gov/about/privacy-information); seal and logos excluded. Fair Access policy: max 10 requests/second, declared User-Agent, no unclassified bots. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Feed carries summaries.

name: Federal Register
policyNote: US government publication, public domain. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents, but document HTML pages redirect automated clients to unblock.federalregister.gov; full text must be fetched from the API's raw_text_url/body_html_url. Feed carries titles only.

name: NASA
policyNote: Text is a US federal work, but NASA's media guidelines say AI outputs must not be attributed to NASA ('References like "according to NASA" ... are prohibited in AI products'), which conflicts with cited summaries. robots.txt allows all. Held at metadata only pending a decision.

name: The Conversation
policyNote: Articles CC BY-ND 4.0 but commercial use needs a paid licence and AI training is prohibited (republishing guidelines). robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot, Google-Extended and Claude agents from /. Metadata only.

name: KFF Health News
policyNote: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; KFF states for-profit outlets may republish, but the licence is non-commercial and summarisation is not covered. Wire photos and 'All Rights Reserved' stories excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Metadata only until permission is confirmed.

name: The Texas Tribune
policyNote: Free republishing under house rules with no named CC licence ('Don't sell the story'); ToS grants only a revocable limited licence; partner stories excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Too vague for commercial processing; metadata only.

name: CalMatters
policyNote: Free republishing under house rules with no named CC licence; ToS forbids automated access and copying or reselling site resources. Wire photos excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Metadata only until permission is confirmed.
